facts.fact: A two-day regional workshop on a common framework for national emergency telecommunications plans opened in Brazzaville on 15 September 2026, convened by the ITU, the Assembly of Central Africa telecom regulators (ARTAC) and Congo's ARPCE, with eight ECCAS states taking part.
facts.system: Assemblée des régulateurs de télécommunications de l'Afrique centrale (ARTAC)
